records.source_format: Mozilla/5.0 (Linux; Android {osVersion}; {uaModel} Build/{build}; wv) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Version/4.0 Chrome/{chromeVersion} Mobile Safari/537.36 [FB_IAB/FB4A;FBAV/{appVersion};IABMV/1;]
review_notes: Candidate from the app implementation, not observed traffic. Must be checked against an independent real UA source before normalization.

records.template: Mozilla/5.0 (Linux; Android 10; K) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Version/4.0 Chrome/158.0.0.0 Mobile Safari/537.36 [FB_IAB/FB4A;FBAV/{appVersion};IABMV/1;]

compatibility.notes: One observed reduced-UA variant. Android 10; K is a literal reduced-UA token, not the handset's actual OS/model. Chrome/158.0.0.0 is held literal; do not replace it with the catalog's Chrome 159 value without a matching observation.

review_notes: The app version/build pair 588.0.0.42.55 / 707615019 exists together in the attached devices-2026.11.25.7.json current values. The UA emits FBAV but not FBBV; the build is joined from the exact catalog version record, not copied from the UA.
This is a distinct no-wv reduced-UA variant. Do not merge it with the older Motorola candidate containing '; wv)' or the Samsung device/build candidate.

Only appVersion is dynamic. The Android 10; K and Chrome/158.0.0.0 base is preserved literally from the observed variant. The current meta.versions.chrome is 159.0.8154.33, so a dynamic Chrome slot is not supported by this observation.
Baseline note resolved 2026-11-26: the spec baseline line was corrected to 2026.11.25.7 (authoritative); the version/build match stands against catalog .7.

records.source_format: Mozilla/5.0 (Linux; {android_version}; {device_model} Build/{build_number}) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Version/4.0 Chrome/{chrome_version} Mobile Safari/537.36 [FB_IAB/FB4A;FBAV/{fb_version};IABMV/1;] OR [FB_IAB/FB4A;FBAV/{fb_version};]

records.source_format: Mozilla/5.0 (iPhone; CPU iPhone OS {iosVersionUnderscored} like Mac OS X) AppleWebKit/605.1.15 (KHTML, like Gecko) Version/17.5 Mobile/15E148 Safari/604.1 [FBAN/FBIOS;FBAV/{appVersion};FBDV/{uaModel};FBMD/iPhone;]
review_notes: Candidate only. The fixed Safari Version/17.5 and Mobile/15E148 values in this implementation are not established as universal current values.

records.source_format: Mozilla/5.0 (iPhone; CPU iPhone OS {ios_version} like Mac OS X) AppleWebKit/{webkit_version} (KHTML, like Gecko) Mobile/{ios_build} Safari/604.1 [FBAN/FBIOS;FBAV/{fb_version};FBBV/{fb_build};FBDV/{device_model};FBMD/iPhone;FBSN/iOS;FBSV/{formatted_ios_version};FBSS/{fbss};FBID/phone;FBLC/{language};FBOP/5;FBRV/{fbrv};IABMV/1]
review_notes: Candidate only. The script mints FBRV and selects randomized WebKit/app version values; these are not backed by the current device/app catalog.

evidence.quoted_text: f"Mozilla/5.0 (iPhone; CPU iPhone OS {ios_version} like Mac OS X) " + "AppleWebKit/{webkit_version} ... [FBAN/FBIOS;FBAV/{fb_version};FBBV/{fb_build};...;FBRV/{fbrv};IABMV/1]"

review_notes: Candidate only. SDK mapping is hard-coded; DPR-derived dpi must not be substituted for a sourced logical-density value without validation.

records.source_format: Mozilla/5.0 (Linux; Android {android}; {model} Build/{build}; wv) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Version/4.0 Chrome/{chrome} Mobile Safari/537.36 Instagram {ig_version} ({api_level_pair}; {density}; {resolution}; motorola; {model}; {chipset}; {locale}; {generated_id}; IABMV/1)
review_notes: Candidate only. The generated ID, app version prefix, chipset labels and density values require independent evidence; physical PPI is not interchangeable with Android logical density.

records.source_format: Mozilla/5.0 (Linux; {android_full}; {model} Build/{build_number}; wv) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Version/4.0 Chrome/{chrome_version} Mobile Safari/537.36 Instagram {instagram_version} Android ({api_level_pair}; {dpi}; {resolution}; {vendor}; {model}; {codename}; {chipset}; {lang}; {generated_id}; IABMV/1)
review_notes: Candidate only. Script generates a per-string identifier and selects random versions; exact device density and chipset token semantics need evidence.

evidence.quoted_text: f"Mozilla/5.0 (Linux; {android_full}; {model} Build/{build_number}; wv) " + "... Instagram {instagram_version} Android ({version_pair}; {dpi}; {resolution}; {vendor}; {model}; {codename}; {chipset}; {lang}; {unique_id}; IABMV/1)"

review_notes: Candidate only. The base Safari values and app-specific token ordering require independent observed-UA corroboration.
